column16: - This layout is intended to maximize the rate of Tzhaar tasks, not XP or GP
- Since the addition of custodians, Nieve may be slightly higher XP than Duradel with an XP focused blocklist
- Add option for Konar Point Boosting
- Add XP rate for Scabarites and set them to Do
- You must check "Like a Boss" on the Configurations page for these to affect calculations
- You can select boss task lengths in column E of the Configurations page
- Boss tasks give a fixed 5,000 XP on completion, hence why choosing a length of 3 can give huge XP rates
